g.text: One graph, three layouts: separation, clutter and crossing costs
Node color = region; size = retained degree. Orange edges = India links. Same 179 nodes and 797 edges in every layout.
Crossings count straight segment interiors, excluding shared endpoints and collinear overlaps; positions do not define similarity.
